Third-party software notice — PDF unlocking engine
==================================================

The file qpdf.wasm in this folder is distributed unmodified from the npm package
@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm@0.3.0 (https://github.com/neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm), which is
a WebAssembly build of qpdf.
